title: Joining the Hiking Club
transcript:
Woman: Hey, you're in the hiking club, right? I saw your table at the club fair.
Man: Yeah! Are you thinking about joining?
Woman: Maybe. But I don't have any gear. No boots, no backpack, nothing.
Man: Don't let that stop you. The club lends equipment to new members for their first semester.
Woman: Seriously? That's a weight off my shoulders.
Man: And our first trip's an easy one. Just three miles around the lake.
Woman: Okay, sign me up.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say, "That's a weight off my shoulders"?
options: To complain about carrying a heavy backpack
To explain that she has a back injury
To suggest that the hikes are too difficult
To show that she is relieved about the equipment
questions.explanation: She was worried about not having gear, so learning the club lends equipment relieves that worry.

questions.stem: What does the man say about the first trip?
options: It is only for experienced members.
questions.explanation: He says the first trip is "an easy one," just three miles around the lake.
